categories.main_business_segments: Nomura Micro Science Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the water treatment equipment business, focusing on the design, construction, sales, and maintenance of ultrapure water production systems and related consumables. The company also engages in the sale of high-purity chemicals and piping materials, but over 90% of its revenue is derived from the water treatment equipment segment, especially for semiconductor, FPD, and pharmaceutical industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies center on ultrapure water production, utilizing advanced filtration and purification methods such as membrane filtration (including RO and UF membranes), ion exchange, activated carbon, and degassing systems. Their production process covers integrated pre-treatment, primary and secondary purification, and system modularization (unitization and skid construction) to meet stringent purity requirements for advanced manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are manufacturers in the semiconductor, flat panel display (FPD), and pharmaceutical sectors, with a particular emphasis on semiconductor fabs requiring high-purity water for production. Major end markets include global semiconductor giants, with Samsung Austin Semiconductor accounting for over 50% of annual sales, as well as pharmaceutical companies in Japan and Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally, with major business regions in Japan, the United States, South Korea, China, and Taiwan. Recent expansion includes establishing a subsidiary in Singapore to strengthen presence in Southeast Asia and entering the Indian market through a major semiconductor water treatment project.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nomura Micro Science is positioned as a midstream and downstream supplier, providing engineered water treatment systems, maintenance, and consumables directly to end-user manufacturing facilities. The company does not manufacture basic materials but integrates, installs, and services complex water purification solutions at customer sites.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening sales capabilities, reforming engineering processes through modularization, and accelerating R&D under the 'SMART UP3' initiative. R&D focuses on enhancing ultrapure water purity, analytical sensitivity, and environmental sustainability, with investments in next-generation systems for advanced semiconductors and new monitoring devices for pharmaceuticals. The company also emphasizes sustainability, diversity, and digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through project-based sales of water treatment systems, ongoing maintenance contracts, and sales of consumables (filters, resins, etc.). The company also offers BOOM (Build Own Operate and Maintenance) contracts, where it owns and operates equipment and charges customers based on ultrapure water usage.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nomura Micro Science is a leading player in the ultrapure water treatment market for semiconductors and pharmaceuticals, competing with global and regional engineering firms specializing in water systems. The company is recognized for its technical expertise and strong relationships with major semiconductor manufacturers, positioning itself as a best-in-class partner in Asia and expanding globally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2025, consolidated sales reached approximately 96.4 billion yen, with operating profit of 15.4 billion yen and net profit of 10.2 billion yen, marking record highs and strong double-digit growth (sales up 32%, profit up 44% YoY). The company has over 580 employees and targets further growth, aiming for 101 billion yen in sales and 14.6 billion yen in operating profit by FY2026.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its ability to deliver highly reliable, integrated ultrapure water solutions tailored to the most demanding semiconductor and pharmaceutical applications. Its value proposition emphasizes technical excellence, rapid response to evolving customer needs, environmental sustainability, and comprehensive after-sales support, making it a trusted partner for mission-critical water infrastructure.
